# Autism Providers of Georgia (APG)

> Autism Providers of Georgia (APG) is a 501(c)(6) nonprofit professional association for organizations and clinicians who provide autism services, including applied behavior analysis (ABA), in Georgia. APG advocates for fair reimbursement, transparent regulation and stable Medicaid policy before the Georgia General Assembly, the Department of Community Health (DCH), the Commissioner of Insurance and Georgia's Medicaid care management organizations (CMOs).

APG is an association, not a therapy provider: it does not deliver ABA therapy or diagnose autism. Contact: info@autismga.org, 5050 Research Court, Suite 125, Suwanee, GA 30024.

## Pages

- [Home](https://autismga.org/): APG's goals, what it does for members, and recent advocacy updates
- [About](https://autismga.org/about): who APG is, where it represents providers, and the board of directors
- [Advocacy & updates](https://autismga.org/updates): advocacy wins, member alerts and policy updates
- [FAQ](https://autismga.org/faq): common questions from providers and families
- [Join](https://autismga.org/join): membership for ABA provider organizations and individual clinicians
- [Contact](https://autismga.org/contact): email, mailing address and social channels
